## What we know

- **Name:** 圆明园石道 (西直门-高梁桥-海淀-大宫门) Yuanming Yuan shidao (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27 · confidence A)
- **In English:** The stone road from 西直门 to the 大宫门 (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27)
- **What it was:** a road outside the garden walls (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27 · confidence A)
- **In 1860:** in use; paved in granite (S241 p.293; S240 pp.227-228; S245 p.227; S247 pp.100-101); French troops marched along it into 海淀 on 6 Oct 1860 (S241 p.287) (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27)
- **Size:** 20 li 西直门-圆明园 (S05 j98:1a); width 廣可三間 (S1229, 1790): about 10 m read as three bays (C) (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27)
- **Width drawn:** 10 m (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27)
- **Where:** C: in the ring along today's 中关村大街 to 海淀黄庄 (=皇庄, j99:22a), through the old town (海淀大街) to 海淀桥, then north on today's 颐和园路 to the PKU west gate; agrees within 150 m with the 1944 main road of the AMS sheet (S20) read by me and placed with the maps worker's affine (rms 95 m): 1944 road (116.3134,39.9718)-(116.3052,39.9812)-(116.3016,39.9819)-(116.3004,39.9899)-(116.3000,39.9963) (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27 · confidence C)
- **Joins:** end at OW042 (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27)
- **Note:** Paved before 1721 (De Lange via S02 p.42); repaired 1724, '畅春园石路' (会典则例 j135); called 圆明园石道 by 1732 (S02 p.49); willows 1724-32 (9,297 in YZ4 from 西直门 to 畅春园); 内务府 planted from 清梵寺 to 圆明园, 工部 from 西直门 to 清梵寺 (j135). Malone p.21: granite blocks still lying beside the 1930s macadam road. 1790 order of places (S1230 j79): 红桥, 清梵寺, 永新庄, 双关帝庙, ... 倚虹堂, 高梁桥, 西直门. Park site page 藻园 (S1234): in 1930, rebuilding the 海淀-玉泉山 macadam road, the whole 4,800 m of 圆明园's south wall was pulled down for road stone. Also: Tour du monde 1864 sketch read, fit rms 427 m (schematic) (the road Hai-tien - Pekin), 3108 m from the point used. Also: LoC Beijing cheng jiao tu c.1886 read, fit rms 226 m (road from the gardens' south-west to Haidian and the city), 1411 m from the point used. (S1228, S05, S1229, S1230, S02, S240, S241, S245, S246, S247, S20, S03, S22, S27)
